Then, when a highly infectious fever hits the cul-de-sac, Zee finds himself playing nurse to all his friends, who display a variety of extreme symptoms. Finally, Jeff accidentally causes Pogo to crash-land, causing him to lose his memory, and Jeff decides to rehabilitate him.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are facing some challenging situations! When Fuse gets a birthday present of a skydiving ticket, he's too proud to tell Bubbles he's scared of heights and tries to face his fears. Then, Zee is cupcake crazy! When he discovers Bubbles is running a cupcake factory out of her house, he finds it impossible to control himself. The challenges continue when Newt crashes one of Fuse's fishing expeditions and turns out to be a natural!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are getting into some magical situations! Pogo is bored, so when he discovers a genie in a magic lamp who grants three wishes, he uses them to try and get his friends in the mood for fun. Then, Jeff wants to impress his friends with his hors d'oeuvres, but he is upstaged by Zee, who has a secret ingredient. Finally, Zee accidentally gets on Bubbles' rescue mission to stop a meteor storm and his surprising talent may be just what she needs!

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: The day takes a disastrous turn when Gramps, and then Zak, are swallowed whole by a giant koi fish! As the rest of the team tries to figure out how to rescue them, their problems get even bigger. They are ambushed by Adilla's roaches, who capture them to be the 'special gift' for Lidia's birthday party. The remaining Insectibles must now escape a bizarre party to save their friends from the belly of a fish.

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: When Adilla fires the roach brothers, Hye and Lo, the Insectibles make a surprising decision and recruit them for a mission to retrieve a Shrinkinator part. This strange new alliance is immediately tested when their quest leads them into a mysterious house. Trapped inside with a community of bonkers bugs and their formidable caretaker, Nurse Bapkis, the team must devise a clever plan to escape.

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: Syd's heart is captured by Norma, a beautiful snail, but her shell holds a shocking secret: it's a vital Shrinkinator part! When Adilla's roaches attack to claim it, Syd must bravely defend his new love. Meanwhile, Chowser makes a solemn vow to protect his beloved caterpillar friends as they prepare to transform into butterflies. However, Adilla has sinister plans for the vulnerable pupas, leading to a desperate fight to save them from her clutches.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Join Blippi for Vehicle Month and discover amazing trucks! Learn about monster trucks with Megan, see why flies love garbage trucks, explore an ice cream truck with Sherry Pop, and see how Kareem the Crane builds a skyscraper.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is wondering, 'How does it work?!' Join Blippi and his robot buddy FETCH on an adventure to find the answers! Blippi shrinks down to fly inside a beehive and learn how honey is made, and explores a garbage truck to find out why flies love it so much. Then, it's a trip through a factory to see how chocolate is made! The adventure even travels through time as Blippi meets his great-grandpa to see the very first cars. Plus, Blippi and FETCH help a nervous crane learn to build a skyscraper!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is your guide to having fun and healthy days! First, have some fun in the sun while learning from Señor Super Sunscreen how to apply sunscreen properly. Then, shrink down with Blippi and Meekah as they travel to Italy to learn how to make an authentic pizza! The adventure continues as Blippi helps a bear get ready for winter hibernation. After a long day of fun, it's time for bed, as a magical book reads a bedtime story about the benefits of a good night's rest!

programme.title: Supa Strikas: Rookie Season
programme.desc: Reporting for practice at the Secret Training Compound, Shakes learns he'll be on the bench with Klaus. He hatches a plan to get extra training at the STC, but in doing so, he unwittingly gives access to an invisible enemy.

programme.title: Supa Strikas: Rookie Season
programme.desc: Recovering from an injury, North Shaw is locked in a safety sphere while his rival gets to surf a giant wave. Watching their conflict, Shakes realizes the dangers of soccer rivalry and decides to contact his ex-best friend to make amends.

programme.title: Supa Strikas: Rookie Season
programme.desc: Tensions run high as Shakes joins the starting lineup for his first match against hometown rivals, Invincible United. Facing screaming fans and crazy pressure, Shakes struggles and decides to take drastic action to prove his worth.

programme.title: Supa Strikas: Rookie Season
programme.desc: When Cool Joe's guitar skills go viral, he must choose between playing the match against Cosmos FC or a concert with a funk legend! Meanwhile, Shakes gets help from his little sister to dig deeper into the mystery surrounding his past.

programme.title: Supa Strikas: Rookie Season
programme.desc: Entertainment guru Ms. Altivo convinces Shakes and Skarra to swap teams on her new reality show. But as hidden cameras capture every moment, the show seems to bring out the worst in Skarra... and in Shakes too!

programme.title: Supa Strikas: Rookie Season
programme.desc: Suspended from the team, Shakes uses the time off to investigate his father's disappearance on Mt. Kilimanjaro. While evading a mad snowboarder and an avalanche, Shakes can't help but monitor his teammates' every move from afar.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Get ready for a tasty day out with Blippi! First, Blippi and Meekah visit a pretzel company to explore shapes and flavors. They get a baking tutorial and make a special cookie-filled pretzel! Then, Blippi visits a gelateria in London to learn the tasty science behind making gelato. The delicious adventure continues at a farm where Blippi learns about growing and harvesting lychees and other tasty fruits and nuts!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: How does a recycling truck work? What happens on a farm? Will this object Sink or Float? Blippi explores the world around us with silly dance moves, fun songs, and awesome adventures. There is so much to learn about, it will make you want to shout 'BLIPPI'!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: It's time for a tremendous playtime with Blippi! First, he heads to Adventure City to ride fun rollercoasters and learn about different types of transportation. Then, at KidsVille Playground, Blippi decides to see how fast he can slide and how high he can kick a ball in a day of competitive fun! The adventure ends as Blippi meets the winner of his 'Blippi in my Hometown' contest for a tea party after playing on a colorful jungle gym.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: It's time for a super fun day with Blippi and Meekah! First, they head to Adventure City Theme Park to ride the rails, meet furry friends and figure out cool ways to learn and play! Then, get ready for a fall-tastic pumpkin patch playdate! Join the best friends as they jump in big bounce houses, get lost in a corn maze and play pumpkin ring toss and hockey! It's a day full of exciting adventures!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is learning awesome facts about all kinds of animals! He and D.BO travel back in time to meet the biggest dinosaurs, like the Argentinosaurus, and even try to keep a T-Rex as a pet for a day! Back in the present, they shrink down to count a shark's teeth with a pilot fish dentist. The adventure continues as Blippi learns how elephants use their trunks to keep cool and discovers why cats have whiskers from a local feline celebrity.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Explore amazing vehicles this Vehicle Month! Help Blippi and Meekah fix the BlippiMobile. See mail delivery, fly a space rocket, visit a construction site, learn about firetrucks, and race a fast Formula 1 car!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are having a tough time! Slick decides he needs to get fit and foolishly accepts Fuse's offer of a 'Boot Camp.' But when it turns out to be too much hard work, Slick decides he's had enough! Then, Newt has an accident with some paint flecks and is misdiagnosed with an infectious tropical illness, forcing her into quarantine. Finally, Pogo and Jeff get into a battle over who can sell the best ice creams, which escalates to destructive levels.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods have some new goals! After a sequence of annoying events, Jeff decides he's had enough and is moving out! The others rally together to convince him to stay. Then, Fuse and Slick are smitten with a female jogger who blows them both a kiss. The pair are determined to outshine one another to prove who the kiss was for. Finally, Zee enters a road endurance race to win a trophy that looks like a gigantic hot dog!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are dealing with some big problems! First, the perfect snowy day inspires Pogo to pull some pranks, but they go too far and he and Newt come face-to-face with a hungry bear! Then, Jeff is throwing a party to impress some snooty friends, but his high expectations cause his waiter to quit, leaving him in a disaster. The trouble continues when Newt is asked to look after a mystery parcel and can't resist taking a peek inside!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are dealing with some big problems! Bubbles accidentally brings back a cute little space alien, but it multiplies at an alarming rate and Oddsville is soon crawling with the creatures! Then, an experiment with Pogo's ice cream makes everyone who eats it weightless. Soon, they're all loving spinning around in the air, but it's not long before they find themselves drifting away! Plus, Fuse tries to get away from everyone by retreating to an island.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Hit the road for Vehicle Month! Join Blippi and Meekah as they fix a flat bike tire at the Spoke Bicycle Cafe. Decorate cool helmets, go for a bike ride, and then head to the skate park to learn the basics of skateboarding!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: It's time to build this Vehicle Month! Join Blippi at a landscaping company and a construction site. Learn about and operate amazing construction vehicles like a bulldozer and an excavator, all while remembering to put safety first!

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Explore space this Vehicle Month! Join Meekah at the Kennedy Space Center to see the Atlantis spacecraft and go on a virtual Mars Mission. Visit Columbia Memorial Space Center to build Apollo 11 and program a Mars Rover!

programme.desc: Topik ini menerangkan tentang pengertian jahiliah. Diperincikan hal kejahilan dalam bidang akidah dan akhlak serta pelbagai pegangan akidah yang dianuti oleh masyarakat jahiliyah. programme.title: Health China
programme.desc: a story of China has always put the people's health at the top of its policy agenda, working hard to improve the health of its population and making universal health a primary goal of development.

programme.title: Possession Street
programme.desc: When seven vengeful spirits turn the tenants of a deserted mall into zombies, a video store owner, his daughter and a feng shui master must battle the zombies as the mall descends into hell.

programme.title: My Country, My Parents
programme.desc: Set against four different eras, this 4-part anthology directed by Wu Jing, Zhang Zi Yi, Xu Zheng & Shen Teng depicts how China's forefathers fought to defend the nation & family honour.

programme.title: Sky on Fire
programme.desc: Directed by Ringo Lam, Daniel Wu stars as a security chief embroiled in a battle to protect a cure for deadly disease from falling into the wrong hands. Joseph Chang & Zhang Ruo Yun co-star.

programme.title: Lonely Eighteen
programme.desc: Two best friends enter the Hong Kong Entertainment industry together in the 1980s but their fates differ. After a decade, their life choices lead them to two different paths in life.

programme.title: A Writer's Odyssey II
programme.desc: Fallen novelist Lu Kong Wen is drawn into his own fictional world, where a villain seeks to invade reality, sparking a cross-dimensional clash that will change both worlds.

programme.title: Mad Fate
programme.desc: A fortune teller predicts that Tung will be imprisoned for murder, he tries to change his fate but a veteran detective believes Tung to be a psychopathic serial killer & pursues him relentlessly.

programme.title: Someone Like Me
programme.desc: Ah Mei, bound by cerebral palsy and her mother's push for a forced hysterectomy, finds love with Ken through a disability intimacy service. Together, they forge a tender bond that defies all barriers.

programme.title: Trouble Girl
programme.desc: Down with ADHD, Xiao Xiao faces school bullies and family issues. Her teacher Paul is her solace, but when she witnesses a secret between her mother and Paul, it adds complexity to her emotions.

programme.title: Ip Man 3
programme.desc: Ip Man fights some gangsters to protect a school, and is challenged by a Wing Chun master. He accepts the duel for his family and disciples and emerges victorious, securing the Grandmaster title.

programme.title: MUMU
programme.desc: Mumu connects her deaf father to the outside world, but their peaceful life is disrupted when she must adapt and fit in to the hearing world, while her father is ensnared by a gang to commit crime.

programme.title: Flashover
programme.desc: Based on a true story, an earthquake causes the gas pipes in an industrial park to break, resulting in explosions & fires in the area. Firefighters must fight to safeguard lives, including their own.

programme.title: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: When an unidentified corpse is found at a residential unit, the residents fear that its presence will turn their home into an ill-fated house, leading to a chaotic endeavor to remove the body.

programme.title: LEIO
programme.desc: An ex-singer returns to his hometown & takes part in a water drilling contest to save his drought-stricken town, only to discover a fierce and deadly beast lurking underground!

programme.title: Don't Forget I Love You
programme.desc: Lu Yao has amnesia & wakes up every day remembering nothing from the day before. He meets psychotherapist Xing Yue & they fall in love despite knowing they have no future together.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Caught in an underground fight to pay off debts, talented boxer Jia Yang loses her Olympics dream and quits boxing. A decade later, Coach Li aids her comeback. Can Jia Yang resurrect her boxing dream?

programme.title: Ultimate Malevolence
programme.desc: Featuring three stories about two high school friends, a magician and a lost man, the movie reveals the most terrifying and ugly side of human nature, where life and death are just a thought away!

programme.title: High Forces
programme.desc: An A380 airliner is hijacked by gunmen on its maiden flight. Among the passengers is a security expert, whose daughter is one of the captives. Can he save all the passengers and avert the crisis?

programme.title: The Movie Emperor
programme.desc: A Hong Kong megastar decides to make a film about rural China to win an award at a film festival. He experiences village life for a farmer's role, but this results in a series of hilarious events.

programme.title: My Indian Boyfriend
programme.desc: The first Bollywood movie made in Hong Kong, it is about an interracial love story between a Hong Kong girl and an Indian boy! Faced with many difficulties, can their love prevail?

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: When a former boxing champ & a rich man's son both enter an MMA competition, they believe they are powerful - until they meet an even more formidable opponent.

programme.title: Busted Water Pipes
programme.desc: With no crime left in town, officer Yu Da Hai stages a fake robbery to save the police from losing their jobs. When a water pipe bursts, chaos erupts and the lines between cops and crooks blur.

programme.title: Bounty Hunters
programme.desc: Five bounty hunters are tasked to track down the culprit of a series of bombings plaguing a hotel group in Bangkok. Can they solve the crime and finally collect the bounty?

programme.title: Burning Stars
programme.desc: During the 1920s White Terror period, agent Li Yimin is tasked with escorting a key figure to safety. Alone and hunted, he reunites with an old ally to escape the enemy's trap.

programme.title: Love is Blind, Hate Too
programme.desc: A year ago, Bo became blind in a serious car accident. One day, an intruder enters her house and takes her hostage. As she tries to survive, she discovers her husband's involvement in her accident!

programme.title: Blades of the Guardians: Wind Rises in the Desert
programme.desc: Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma escorts the most wanted fugitive across the desert to Chang'an, only to be drawn into a plot that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world.

programme.title: Smashing Frank
programme.desc: After a jewelry store heist, the young thieves left behind a graffiti tag that reads 'FRANK', sparking public curiosity about their motives. What message are they trying to convey?

programme.title: The Italian Recipe
programme.desc: Celebrity Peng travels to Rome for the shooting of a reality show and encounters an ordinary girl, Man Man, who dreams of becoming a great chef after migrating to Italy.

programme.title: Cliff Walkers
programme.desc: Zhang Yi Mou's first spy thriller follows four Communist Party special agents who embark on a secret mission in the Japanese puppet state of Manchukuo - only to be sold out by a traitor.

programme.title: Look Up
programme.desc: Celebrating the 25th anniversary of HK's Handover with an anthology of 4 stories about an autistic young man, a reconciliation, a Chinese opera star & a Nepali youth.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey Part I - A Pandora's box
programme.desc: In this Stephen Chow vehicle, a once divine but now human Monkey King needs the titular box to send him back in time.

programme.title: Wild City
programme.desc: Hong Kong director Ringo Lam returns after seven years with this action drama in which a cop-turned-bar-owner & his brother are pulled into a gang war.

programme.title: Shining for One Thing
programme.desc: Zhang Wan Sen plans to confess his crush on Lin Bei Xing after the exam. When an accident changes everything tragically, Zhang travels back in time. Can he amend things this time?

programme.title: Beyond The Sin

programme.title: 8 Bucks Tycoon
